//: SysPerf configuration. Copy to your data directory as sysperf.config.json.
//_note: Every key is optional. Anything omitted keeps its built-in default. Restart SysPerf after editing.
//_server: Loopback only by default. Setting a non-loopback host makes SysPerf generate and require an auth token, written back into this file.
//_sampling: sample_seconds is the fast tier. The slow tier (services, startup, network, hardware, drivers) runs every full_every-th sample because it costs a few seconds.
//_scoring: Counts breathe constantly, so the score uses a rolling median of the last score_smooth_window samples rather than the latest reading. Set to 1 to score the raw value. regress_band_pct is the noise dead-band before a metric counts as regressed.
//_wifi: Wi-Fi is scored per NETWORK, not against an absolute Mbps ladder — the radio's job is to not be the bottleneck for the connection behind it. Put your SSID in plan_mbps with the speed you actually pay for (e.g. {"MyHome": 100}); the link then scores against that and reaches 100% once it can carry the whole plan, instead of demanding gigabit Wi-Fi for a 100 Mbps line. Any network you do not list calibrates against the best it has sustained (capability_pctl). phy_efficiency is the fraction of the negotiated PHY rate TCP actually realises.
//_targets: Fractions of THIS machine's capacity, applied once when the baseline is captured. Raising a fraction makes the target easier; lowering it makes it stricter.
//_adaptive: The personal-best layer. Learns each metric's own history and sets a stretch goal just beyond your best day.
//_trends: Long-term usage record: how much history to keep, the window the daily-typical drift is measured over, and how many settled days without a pass count as chronic.
//_autoimprove: Autonomous loop: scans every interval_seconds and, below threshold, diagnoses and remediates. mode is the INITIAL mode (the dashboard's choice is persisted). Execution also requires fixes.enabled; only 'safe' fixes ever run unattended.
//_browser_hosts: Which applications' embedded-browser (WebView2) processes you cannot close, and which are merely in use. Add your own — anything unlisted counts as discretionary and raises the number SysPerf expects you to reduce.
//_advisor: Recommendations. reboot_after_hours is when long uptime starts being suggested as a fix.
//_privacy: No data ever leaves the machine. anonymize additionally replaces application and device names with stable hashes in the API payload, so the dashboard is safe to screen-share.
